title: Adorables Papas Fritas con Forma de Gato en Empaque Temático de Gato con Efecto Translúcido
prompt: A close-up scene under warm indoor lighting: an adorable cat-themed potato chip bag sits open on a white plate placed on a wooden table. The bag is red and decorated with cute illustrated cats in a soft, comforting style. Inside, it is filled with uniquely shaped chips — each chip is shaped like a cat's head, complete with cute eyes, a mouth, and whiskers. The chips have a golden, crispy appearance, and they are extremely thin, allowing the light to shine through them with a beautiful, delicate effect. Shallow depth of field, vivid detail, realistic photography style, macro effect, soft natural lighting, high resolution; the overall atmosphere is warm, cute, playful, and highly creative.
